title: I built a 90-second Rush Mode for my brain puzzle game using AI coding assistance
author: TargetLabs
selftext:
I’m a solo developer working on Dice Target, a mobile brain puzzle game.

I’ve been using AI coding assistance with Claude Code to help develop and improve the game.

This clip shows Rush Mode, where players have 90 seconds to solve as many dice puzzles as possible.

One thing I’ve learned is that AI can speed up implementation, but getting the gameplay and user experience right still requires plenty of testing and iteration.

I’m curious how other solo developers use AI coding tools when building and refining game mechanics.  
How much of your development workflow relies on AI?
